title: Typo on English string
symptom: The English string in the app has a typo: 'ony' instead of 'only' in the text 'Start to work around noisy readings even on very low noise levels (engineering mode ony)'.
cause: The typo was introduced or overwritten during a sync between Crowdin and GitHub.
fix: The typo was fixed in Crowdin and pushed to GitHub.
evidence_quote: Thanks for reporting it. I've fixed this already but it got overwritten by the last sync between crowdin and GitHub.
